evidence: Carries the Tests label and refactors unit test cases and local test helpers in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp as part of a general test cleanup effort (#36692).
rationale: Refactors test_IsStandard to eliminate shared mutable globals and isolate test cases, improving test code cleanliness. As noted in the PR description, it 'splits it into one test case per policy rule, each building its own transaction... so no case changes policy for another', preventing potential state leakage across assertions. Within test infrastructure, routine test code cleanup that does not fix CI flakiness or provide shared framework capabilities is marginal in priority.
